Why Software Needs Hardware
Software needs hardware to run. A program is only text until a processor runs it. A processor needs power, memory, and a clock. Each part has one job.

Hardware also needs software. A circuit board does nothing without code. The code tells each chip what to do. Together they make a useful tool.

You can see this in a phone. The screen detects a touch. The processor reads the touch. The app responds to it. Each step depends on the one before.
